positions.name: PipelineObligationWhenIdAbsent
positions.frame: what must the pipeline do when a memory is submitted without an explicit id field?
positions.why: src-1 states the triggering condition — a submission lacking an explicit id field — and src-2 mandates the pipeline's required response: produce a slug from memory content (via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback) and commit the file successfully. Both expressions cohere under one directional read about the pipeline's obligation in the absence of an explicit id. The conviction gradient (src-1 a flat claim of fact, src-2 a performed mandate) is the condition-then-obligation structure itself, not a disqualifying split.
